# The grid's hover-sync suspend and resume are routed without a windowId

## Context

Seen in the App Worker console during the D#18224 popup-birth arm (`apps/workstation` at `dev@2ee23d7801`, Playwright e2e rig): every scroll of the Feed grid logs two warnings —

```
sendMessage destination "main" is deprecated. Use a windowId instead.
{"action":"remoteMethod","data":{"id":"neo-base-33"},"destination":"main","remoteClassName":"Neo.main.addon.GridRowHoverSync","remoteMethod":"suspendHover"}
… remoteMethod: "resumeHover"
```

`neo-base-33` is the grid's `Neo.grid.ScrollManager`. The warning is the engine telling us the call carried no routing key and went to the first connected port (`src/worker/Base.mjs:478–484`) — the same routing class #18276 found for the Workspace geometry arm.

## The Problem

`ScrollManager#suspendGridRowHoverSyncAddon` and `#resumeGridRowHoverSyncAddon` (`src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs:227–246`) resolve the addon for the right window — `Neo.currentWorker.getAddon('GridRowHoverSync', windowId)` — and then call it with `{id: me.id}` only. The remote-method proxy routes on the payload's `windowId`; without one the message falls back to `ports[0]`. In a single window that is the same window, so only the warning shows. With the grid in a popup (the pop-out the arm measured), `ports[0]` is the opener: its `GridRowHoverSync` addon receives `suspendHover`/`resumeHover` for an id it never registered and does nothing, while the popup's addon, which does hold the registration, is never told — so hover sync is not suspended while the popped-out grid scrolls. (Derived from the routing; the popup-side effect is not yet measured — the arm's headed scroll ran in the opener.)

The sibling in the same class already does it right: `updateGridHorizontalScrollSyncAddon` passes `windowId` in both `register` and `unregister` payloads (`:340–350`).

## The Fix

Pass `windowId` in both hover-sync payloads (`addon.suspendHover({id: me.id, windowId})`, same for resume) — two lines, mirroring the horizontal-sync sibling. Consider one private `callRowHoverSyncAddon(method, windowId)` so the two methods stop diverging.

| `ScrollManager#suspendGridRowHoverSyncAddon` / `resume…` (`:227–246`) | `worker/Base#sendMessage` routing contract; sibling `:340–350` | payload carries `windowId`; the call reaches the window that holds the registration | — | method docblocks | no deprecated-destination warning during a scroll; a popped-out grid's hover sync suspends in its own window |

## Decision Record impact

`none`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit, red-first: with a mocked addon, a scroll on a `ScrollManager` whose `windowId` is `'w2'` calls `suspendHover` and `resumeHover` with `windowId: 'w2'` in the payload (today: no `windowId`).
- [ ] Headed: scrolling the Workstation Feed grid logs no `sendMessage destination "main" is deprecated` warning for `GridRowHoverSync`.
- [ ] Headed (popup): after a pop-out, a scroll in the popup suspends and resumes hover sync in the popup window (the opener's addon receives nothing).

## Out of Scope

- The geometry arm's routing (#18276) and the row `windowId` relay (#18291, PR #18294) — same class, separate leaves.
- Retiring the `ports[0]` fallback itself: the deprecation warning is doing its job; this leaf removes one caller.
